Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.web.controller

Class WikiController

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.web.controller.WikiController
@Controller @RequestMapping("/wiki") public class WikiController extends Object
Thymeleaf controller for the public read-only wiki view.

Provides three pages:

  • GET /wiki — browsable index of all wiki pages with search + type filter
  • GET /wiki/{slug} — page detail with rendered markdown, provenance table, contradictions, related pages, and revision history
  • GET /wiki/contradictions — recent contradictions feed (Reversal Watch preview)

All wiki pages are public (/wiki/** is permitAll() in SecurityConfig). Provenance links resolve SourceRef.articleId() to the original article URL via NewsArticleRepository.
